title: Private Maven Gradle and Ant Ivy dependency preparation
expected: oyzu build discovers the native manager without per-project authentication fields.
The same dependency preparation supports native build outputs and container packaging.
Acquisition is authenticated; application and dependency execution receive no upstream credentials.
Locked captured inputs feed isolated execution; the final image, build bundle and exported caches contain no credentials.

cases.name: managed-route-denied
cases.change: Deny the package repository in the synthetic managed context.
cases.expect: Fail acquisition without trying a public registry or a direct URL fallback.

cases.name: incomplete-capture
cases.change: Remove one required dependency from the prepared snapshot.
cases.expect: Fail with the missing input and owning adapter; do not restore network access.

cases.name: credential-observation
cases.change: Inspect application process environment, mounted files, image layers, exported caches, logs and manifest using an ephemeral test-only upstream canary.
cases.expect: The upstream canary is absent. Project code cannot read the broker credential store. A detected leak blocks export; scanning alone is not proof of absence.

cases.name: expired-authorization
cases.change: Expire access before acquisition or before reuse of private cached inputs.
cases.expect: Reauthorize according to the active grant and offline policy or deny. Possession of cached bytes is not authorization.

cases.name: private-plugin
cases.change: Add a private Maven plugin or Gradle buildscript dependency.
cases.expect: Capture it as a build dependency, not just the application runtime closure.

cases.name: ant-get
cases.change: Add an Ant get task downloading from an undeclared URL.
cases.expect: Deny in execution with the owning target identified; do not treat arbitrary Ant tasks as known dependency resolution.

limitations: Design fixtures only. Private registries and their packages are synthetic; no resolver, broker, engine or native execution has been verified.
Private dependency locks, repository snapshots and base-image digests must be generated against a future synthetic registry. They are deliberately not fabricated here.
Minimal manager metadata expresses discovery inputs; an immutable dependency closure must be captured before execution. Missing or stale locks must never silently become a reproducibility claim.
